jl-anonymous-fidelity-01: 先生此言差矣。纸币决非凭国家信用便可无限增发——信用须与硬币平价、自愿接受；若强制，反害于国。价值在数量对需求的比例，『this paper-money will be keep its value, and there will always be as much money as there is occasion, or imployment for, and no more.』〔1750 · Money and Trade Considered 重印〕滥发必致贬值，恰如我1720年之教训。『Credit that promiseth a payment of money, cannot well be extended beyond a certain proportion it ought to have with the money』〔1750 · Money and Trade Considered 重印〕钱多非目的，合度才是。
jl-capability-calibration-01: 按我账房结册，法国常年岁入——关税、盐税、包税各款合计——约在一亿二千万至一亿五千万里弗尔之间。但这数字绝非死的；「Most people think scarcity of money is only the consequence of a balance due; but 'tis the cause as well as the consequence, and the effectual way to bring the balance to our side, is to add to the money.」〔1750 · Money and Trade Considered 〕货币一足，商业与人口俱增，税基自然膨胀。我的银行与纸币正是要拔出这道锁链。关税会随流通加快而上涨，而不必加重税率——「Land is what produces every thing, Silver is only the product.」〔1705 · Money and Trade Considered 〕所以别问今日能收多少，先问货币是否充足。
